fullContentHtml:
Download App Get Started for Free

The Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission (CGPSC) conducted the State Service Mains Exam from 6th to 9th June 2026. The exam was conducted for 239 vacancies under the CGPSC State Service Examination for 2025 cycle. Several candidates gave the exam to secure Group A & Group B positions like Deputy Collector, DSP & Naib Tehsildar. The CGPSC Mains Result 2026 has now been released @psc.cg.gov.in. Candidates can check the qualifying status by logging into the website. They can also download the CGPSC Mains merit list, result PDF, interview dates & check the next stages of the recruitment process.

CGPSC Mains Result 2026 Out @psc.cg.gov.in.

The Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission has announced the mains result of CGPSC exam for all candidates who appeared in the main exam from 6th to 9th June 2026. Candidates can access the qualifying status & scorecard online through the activated official result portal. Answer sheets have been evaluated to generate candidate scorecards and the merit list PDF. Shortlisted candidates whose roll numbers appear in the merit list PDF are provisionally qualified for the Interview / Personality Test & Document Verification stages.

CGPSC Mains Result 2026

Candidates can review the details & summary of the CGPSC State Service Exam 2025-26 cycle below

Particulars Details
Exam Name CGPSC State Service Main Examination 2026
Conducting Body Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission (CGPSC)
Total Vacancies 239
Recruitment Cycle 2025
Total Marks 1,400 Marks (7 Papers of 200 Marks each)
Exam Date 6th to 9th June 2026
Result Status Released
Interview Dates 21st September 2026 Onwards
Required Credentials Roll Number / Application Number & Date of Birth / Password
Official Portals psc.cg.gov.in / ecgpsc.cgstate.gov.in

Check Out CGPSC Mains Cut Off Here!

CGPSC Mains Results 2026 PDF Download Link

The direct CGPSC Mains Results 2026 PDF Download Link is now active on the official CGPSC portal. Candidates can download the official shortlist PDF containing the details like roll numbers of qualified applicants as well as view the individual scorecards. The CGPSC Mains Score Card provides subject wise breakdown across all 7 papers, total normalized scores & category-wise qualifying status.

Download CGPSC Mains Result 2026 PDF

What Are The Steps to Check CGPSC Mains Result 2026?

Candidates can follow the steps provided as under to download the scorecard & merit list via the CGPSC Mains Result login portal

  1. Visit the official website @psc.cg.gov.in.
  2. Click on the “CGPSC State Service Mains 2026 Result” on the homepage
  3. Open the result login page of website
  4. Enter the Roll No. / Application No. & Password or Date of Birth
  5. Fill in the security captcha & click on Submit
  6. View the result & score card.
  7. Download and print the CGPSC Mains 2026 result PDF / scorecard for future reference

Check Out CGPSC Previous Year Question Paper Here!

CGPSC Mains Score Card 2026

The CGPSC Mains Score Card 2026 is available for download on the official website. Candidates can log in to view the performance across all descriptive papers including Language, Essay, General Studies I, II, III, IV & V. Make sure to take multiple printouts of the scorecard as it is needed during the interview & document verification stages

Details Mentioned on the CGPSC Mains Score Card

Candidates must verify all details printed on their CGPSC Mains 2026 Result marksheet

  • Candidate’s Full Name
  • Roll Number & Application Number
  • Category & Sub-Category (UR / OBC / SC / ST / EWS / PwD)
  • Domicile Status (Chhattisgarh Domicile / Other State)
  • Paper-wise Marks Obtained (Paper I to Paper VII)
  • Total Score Obtained (Out of 1,400)
  • Category Cut-Off Score
  • Final Selection Status for Interview / Personality Test

Get complete details on CGPSC Mains Exam Analysis Here!

CGPSC Mains Qualifying Marks & Cut Off

Candidates must get the minimum category wise qualifying marks set by CGPSC to secure a place on the official CGPSC Mains merit list

Category Minimum Qualifying Percentage Minimum Qualifying Marks (Out of 1,400)
General / Unreserved (UR) 33% Aggregate 462 Marks
Scheduled Caste (SC) 23% Aggregate 322 Marks
Scheduled Tribe (ST) 23% Aggregate 322 Marks
Other Backward Classes (OBC) 23% Aggregate 322 Marks
Economically Weaker Section (EWS) 33% Aggregate 462 Marks
Persons with Disabilities (PwD) 23% Aggregate 322 Marks

Check Out CGPSC State Service Books Here!

What Next After CGPSC Mains Result 2026?

Candidates who qualify in the CGPSC Mains Result 2026 proceed to the final selection stages

  • Interview / Personality Test: Candidates who clear the exam are called for the interview carrying 150 marks for personal suitability for state administrative services
  • Document Verification : Verification of educational certificates, age proof, domicile status, caste certificates & identification documents of the candidates
  • Medical Examination: Candidates must satisfy the physical standards & medical fitness criteria for executive posts like DSP, Assistant Jail Superintendent & District Excise Officer
  • Final Merit List & Appointment : Final merit list is made on combined marks of Mains (1,400 Marks) & Interview (150 Marks)

We hope the article on the CGPSC Mains Result 2026 was informative. Candidates can also reach out to us in case of any queries. Candidates can also start preparing for all types of government exams & get quicker access to any information through our Testbook App.

CGPSC Mains Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. Is the CGPSC Mains Result 2026 declared?

Yes the Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission has released the CGPSC Mains 2026 Result @psc.cg.gov.in.

Q2. How can the candidates download the CGPSC Mains Results 2026 PDF ?

Visit psc.cg.gov.in, click on the State Service Examination Mains 2026 Result link & download the merit list PDF file

Q3. What details are needed for CGPSC Mains Result login ?

Candidates need the Roll No. / Application No. & Date of Birth or Password to log in

Q4. What were the exam dates for CGPSC Mains 2026?

The CGPSC State Service Main Exam was conducted from 6th to 9th June 2026

Q5. What is the total mark distribution for CGPSC Mains Exam ?

The CGPSC Mains exam consists of 7 descriptive papers carrying 200 marks each making a total of 1,400 marks

Q6. What is the next stage after qualifying in the CGPSC Mains Result 2026?

Candidates who qualify in the Mains result are called for the Interview / Personality Test (150 Marks) followed by Document Verification & Medical Exam
